adjudication.rationale: The diff verifiably changes `GroupsController#members` from `render_serialized(members.to_a, GroupUserSerializer)` (a bare JSON array) to `render json: { members: ..., meta: ... }` (object with `members` and `meta`) in `app/controllers/groups_controller.rb`. Internal Ember code is updated to consume `result.members`/`result.meta` (`Discourse.Group#findMembers`), but there is no versioning or compatibility shim shown in the diff, so any external client/plugin expecting an array from `GET /groups/:name/members(.json)` could break. This is a concrete compatibility concern, though not necessarily an internal functional defect.
